title: Hosted strict tool catalog gate exits unverified without a retained failure category
surface: Guarded hosted release tool catalog gate
organization_context: Configured member organization supplied by the hosted release gate
preconditions: Hosted release run 39097720360 checks source 789bfa027 with pinned AI Dream ddd709c.
The strict tool catalog gate runs before candidate publication.
reproduction: Inspect hosted release run 39097720360 and its sanitized failure artifact 12125795148.
Observe catalog:tools:drift:strict exit 3 and candidate v0.2.533 not published.
Observe that the artifact identifies only gate and exit code; raw gate output remains on the temporary runner.
expected: A failed strict gate blocks publication and retains a safe category showing which verification boundary was unavailable.
actual: Publication stopped correctly, but run 39097720360 did not retain whether catalog reads, server contract verification, or bundle membership verification failed. A separate local read-only gate passed with 83 advertised tools, 83 DB definitions, 83 bindings and two surfaces.
reproducibility: The captured hosted artifact deterministically omits the category; the underlying CI-only exit-3 branch cannot be reconstructed from it.
severity: S2: release blocked with insufficient diagnosis.
priority: P1: retain the next strict failure category before repeating a guarded release.
cause: release.sh saves raw gate output in an ephemeral latest.log, while its hosted failure artifact uploads only gate name, exit code and candidate. The gate has three distinct exit-3 verification paths.
sibling_census: The same sanitized failure path handles all three strict tool-drift exit-3 branches; each now emits a fixed category that the artifact parser allowlists.
reviewer: Independent focused peer review: behavior PASS and code quality PASS; hosted retest pending.
acceptance_criteria: A failed hosted run retains only catalog-read, server-contract, bundle-membership or unknown, without raw tokens, URLs or response bodies.
One guarded hosted retest identifies the actual unavailable boundary or passes the strict gate before this defect closes.

verification.focused: 8/8 targeted gate diagnostics and gate-auth tests pass; pnpm compile, full lint, focused Biome, Bash syntax and git diff --check pass.
verification.peer: Independent peer verdict A PASS and B PASS.
verification.hosted: Pending; failed run 39097720360 predates category capture.

limitations: This repair adds safe failure diagnosis only; the CI-only verification cause is unresolved.
No hosted release was dispatched from this diagnosis lane.
next_action: After the separate CI spend audit, the release owner runs one guarded hosted release and uses the retained category to repair the failing verification boundary or confirm the gate passes.

transition_history.reason: Hosted strict exit 3 stopped publication without retaining its failing boundary.
Safe category capture passed focused tests and peer review; exact hosted cause and retest remain open.
